newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread says to reorganise leisure.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread says to reorganise leisure.

text.p: Brewer-to-leisure group Whitbread Plc said on Thursday it would reorganise its restaurant, hotel and leisure division after the appointment of David Thomas as chief executive.
"It will enable the management teams to focus specifically on the development of their brands while at the same time simplifying structures and reducing costs," said Thomas in a statement.
Thomas succeeds Peter Jarvis as Whitbread Plc chief executive in the summer.

The company will create five separate business groups from March 3 whereas formerly they all came under the Restaurants and Leisure division. The five are Restaurants, the Whitbread Hotel Company, the 300-strong chain of Beefeater Restaurant and Pub, off-licence chain Thresher and David Lloyd Leisure.
The company also appointed Richard Simpson, formerly finance director of the Restaurant and Leisure Division, as managing director of the Restaurant business.
